ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: combined_stable_loss_v3_fixed
ir.intuition: Replace unavailable median with mean as fallback to preserve adaptive nonlinear margin based on delta_rank in pairwise margin loss.
ir.pseudocode:
eps = 1e-8
margin = batch['log_prob_w'] - batch['log_prob_l']
delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']
delta_rank_mean = mean(delta_rank)
delta_rank_std = sqrt(mean((delta_rank - delta_rank_mean)**2) + eps)
delta_rank_median = delta_rank_mean
alpha = extra.get('alpha', 1.3)
beta = 0.15 * delta_rank_std
bias = 0.4 * delta_rank_median
scaled_delta = tanh(delta_rank / (delta_rank_std + eps))
adjusted_margin = alpha * margin - beta * scaled_delta
biased_margin = adjusted_margin + bias
clipped_margin = clamp(biased_margin, -8.0 + bias, 12.0 - bias)
loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(clipped_margin)
weight = batch.get('weight', ones_like(clipped_margin))
loss = sum(loss_per_pair * weight) / sum(weight)
return loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(delta_rank)
    diff = ops.sub(delta_rank, delta_rank_mean)
    variance = ops.mean(ops.mul(diff, diff))
    delta_rank_std = ops.sqrt(variance + eps)

    # Median op unavailable, fallback to mean for median approximation
    delta_rank_median = delta_rank_mean

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', 1.3))
    beta = 0.15 * delta_rank_std
    bias = 0.4 * delta_rank_median

    scaled_delta = ops.tanh(ops.div(delta_rank, delta_rank_std + eps))
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    adjusted_margin = ops.sub(ops.mul(alpha, margin), ops.mul(beta, scaled_delta))
    biased_margin = ops.add(adjusted_margin, bias)

    lower_bound = ops.sub(-8.0, ops.neg(bias))  # -8.0 + bias
    upper_bound = ops.sub(12.0, bias)
    clipped_margin = ops.clamp(biased_margin, lower_bound, upper_bound)

    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(clipped_margin))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)
    loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), ops.sum(weight) + eps)
    return loss
